The following market refers to Jalen Royals in the Los Angeles C vs Kansas City professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 18, 2026. If Jalen Royals is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once Jalen Royals takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
